purpose: Trial 5 — ppt Home 페이지 통째 dogfood. H2(form-heavy 페이지 cascade 재확인) + H3(needs 누적) + H4(form-heavy 신규 needs) 동시 검증.

steps.name: prep-and-branch
steps.summary: design_system tokens+web build+pack. ppt frontend reinstall (Trial 4 lockfile/changes는 stash로 격리). main에서 trial-5-home branch 분기. Home.tsx R19-only API 자취 0 확인. spec §3 매핑 8행 line 재확인.

steps.name: home-tsx-replace-part1
steps.summary: Textarea/Card import 추가. inline <textarea>→<Textarea resize=none> (native attr 8개 통과). AI 다듬기 inline <button>+style 3종→<Button variant=outline size=sm>+svg+text. PDF dropzone <div>→<Card padding=md> (시각도 inline 0 → dashed 손실은 의도된 evidence). 삭제 inline text-link→<Button variant=danger size=sm>. tsc clean, hex 0.

steps.name: home-tsx-replace-part2
steps.summary: Verbosity 5-pill→<Button variant={selected?'primary':'outline'} size=sm> prop 토글. slideCount badge/Audience select/Error alert는 그대로 유지 (각각 needs evidence 기록). 첫 인상: Verbosity primary 시각 무거움 → ToggleGroup needs evidence.

steps.name: capture-and-analyze
steps.summary: ppt dev server port 3004 fallback (3000~3003 점유). default 캡쳐 39522bytes + with-pdf fixture 캡쳐 39715bytes. AI 시각 분석 8행 매트릭스 채움. H2 ✅(cascade form-heavy 재입증), H3 Badge 4회 누적 강함, H4 ToggleGroup mid 첫 등장.

steps.name: trial-doc-and-close
steps.summary: docs/dogfood-trial-5.md 작성 완료 (Trial 1~4 형식). 매트릭스 8행 + H2/H3/H4 결론 + Trial 4→Trial 5 누적 ranking. phases/index.json에 phase 12 누락 entry + 13 entry 추가. spec S1~S10 자동/정성 모두 ✅. ≥163 tests passing 유지.
